findings.area: assistant-fab overlapping agenda row (I DAG · Tour de France Femmes 2026)
findings.issue: The fixed circular 'Assistent' button (bottom-right, sparkle icon) sits directly on top of the 13:00 'Tour de France Femmes 2026' row, covering its info (i) icon and expand chevron. Confirmed with a cropped clip screenshot at the button's actual bounding box (x:320,y:839, 41x46px on a 375-wide viewport) — the button overlaps live card content, not just empty margin. This is at least the fourth consecutive day this exact bug has been observed (2026-07-30, 2026-07-31, 2026-08-01, 2026-08-02), landing on a different row each time because the agenda content shifts day to day — the fixed button still has no reserved safe-area and keeps occluding whatever row happens to sit in its bottom-right corner.

findings.area: assistant-fab overlapping agenda row (I DAG · Aalesund – Tromsø)
findings.issue: Same fixed 'Assistent' button lands one row lower here (viewport is slightly taller), covering the tail of 'Aalesund – Tromsø' (the last letters of 'Tromsø' are hidden behind the button) plus its info/chevron icons. Tapping in that bottom-right corner risks opening the assistant instead of the event row.

At this width the button renders as a labelled pill ('Assistent') sitting in the empty right-hand margin beside the agenda column (capped at 640px, confirmed centered) and does not overlap any card text — no issue here. Reconfirms the bug is specific to narrow/full-width mobile viewports where there is no side margin for the FAB to live in.

notes: Correctness otherwise looked solid across all three widths: no truncated Norwegian team/athlete names (Aalesund–Tromsø, KFUM Oslo–Kristiansund, Molde–Sarpsborg 08, Lyn–Sogndal, Brann–Rosenborg, Sandefjord–KFUM Oslo, Vålerenga–Bodø/Glimt, Viking–Sarpsborg 08, Stabæk–Lyn, Start–Fredrikstad all read in full, wrapping to multiple lines rather than clipping), every row shows a channel (TV 2 Play, VG+ Sport, HBO Max (Sport)) or an honest faint '-' (National Bank Open presented by Rogers, still undated), all Norwegian-relevant — no FOX/ESPN/Sky spotted. Union Saint-Gilloise – Bodø/Glimt correctly shows Bodø/Glimt's own crest and TV 2 Play, not a foreign channel.

Club crests and national flags render correctly at all widths (Aalesund, Tromsø, KFUM Oslo, Molde, Sarpsborg 08, Lyn, Sogndal, Brann, Rosenborg, Vålerenga, Bodø/Glimt, Viking, Stabæk, Start, Fredrikstad, Sandefjord, Union Saint-Gilloise) — no broken-image icons observed.

Multi-day events (PostNord Tour of Denmark, Rocket Classic, Tour de France Femmes, Tour de Pologne, Wyndham Championship, National Bank Open) render with date ranges + 'neste: Etappe ...' framing instead of a single misleading time.

Layout is a clean single column at 375/393, no horizontal scroll or edge clipping, day-group headings (I DAG / I MORGEN / weekday names) and dividers aligned, must-see accent dots used sparingly. At 900px the agenda column is genuinely centered with roughly equal margins each side, not left-stuck.

Header, Morgenbriefen headline, day groupings, 'Dette dekker vi'/'Merker og kilder' disclosures and footer (usage budget line, calendar subscribe, Aktivitet/Personvern links) all intact and readable at every width checked.

The assistant-fab overlap is now confirmed on (at least) four consecutive runs, each on a different row - a structural bug (position: fixed with no bottom-content safe-area reservation and no narrow-viewport behavior change), not a one-off. Worth prioritizing for the ui-fix loop: e.g. add bottom padding to the agenda equal to the FAB's height + margin, or hide/shrink the FAB below a width breakpoint where it has no side margin to live in.

Could not assess: whether the overlap also steals the tap target in a live browser (only static screenshots were reviewed here, including a clip screenshot at the button's exact bounding box to confirm true content overlap vs. adjacent whitespace).
